summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated 727KB payload
details: The package's preinstall hook runs setup.mjs, which downloads a Bun runtime tarball from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (platform/arch-specific), unpacks it to a temporary directory, chmods the binary executable, and invokes it against the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a single-line ~727KB script marked `// @bun @bun-cjs` using a rotated string-array packer with randomized identifiers, and setup.mjs itself is obfuscated with `_0x...` identifier mangling and decoy string-lookup objects. The package is published as a billing-shared library and ships no legitimate need for an alternate language runtime; fetching Bun exists solely to execute the opaque payload out of view of Node-based tooling on the installer's machine at `npm install` time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
